name: Meshech
overview: Meshech appears in Scripture both as a son of Japheth and, in another instance, as a son of Shem, reflecting some variation in genealogical records (Genesis 10:2; 1 Chronicles 1:5, 1 Chronicles 1:17). The name also identifies a tribe or people group known for their commerce and military presence, as seen in Ezekiel's references to their trading activities and their formidable reputation (Ezekiel 27:13; Ezekiel 32:26). Psalm 120:5 metaphorically portrays dwelling in Mesech as a place of hardship, emphasizing the challenging circumstances associated with this name. Together, these passages reveal Meshech as both an ancestral figure and a people significant in biblical history and prophecy.
